slides.prompt:
Use case: productivity-visual
Asset type: complete rasterized presentation slide
Primary request: create one polished 16:9 Chinese presentation slide for the role "cover".
Communication purpose: 建立主题和核心判断
Single claim: AI 原生知识工作流
Audience: 产品团队、知识工作者与组织管理者
Art direction: contemporary academic publishing with evidence-led calm and intellectual clarity
Composition/framing: publication hierarchy, measured whitespace, figure-led evidence, restrained annotation
Color palette: soft white, graphite, institutional green, muted burgundy
Typography: scholarly Chinese serif headline with highly readable sans-serif labels
Imagery: research environment, documentary evidence, or restrained scientific abstraction. Page-specific visual brief: 城市、网络与知识流动形成的克制视觉意象
Material classification: image; use the matching visual representation and do not invent factual content.
Continuity anchor: academic-anchor; continuity group: academic-deck.
Materials/textures: archival paper, double rules, subtle figure captions
Theme consistency anchors: double green rule; figure-number convention; small burgundy emphasis
Text (verbatim, 文字必须逐字准确、顺序一致、每条只出现一次):
1. "AI 原生知识工作流"
2. "把散落信息变成持续可用的判断"
Constraints: render the complete slide as a single finished image; readable from a projector; strong hierarchy; generous whitespace; no editable UI; no watermark（无水印）; no logo.
Avoid: futuristic glow; sales language; stock graduation imagery; ornamental borders; 不得添加任何其他文字; 乱码; 伪造数据; dense card grid; tiny labels.
